scope: Finite canonical native spectra and complete declared interferometric readouts. GeV values are conditional calibration outputs, not identified particle masses.

parameters.preparation: uniform Gauss fibers plus explicit eigenvector superpositions
parameters.spectral_measurement: declared complete H eigenbasis; all 87 real eigenvectors archived as columns; resolving a degenerate basis is an added apparatus choice
parameters.interference_measurement: two rank-one superposition projectors and their complement; supplied cross-branch phase reference and nonlocal spectral POVM, not implemented by native C/E alone
parameters.native_readout_scope: energy PVM and event-record probabilities are separate marginals; no joint record-by-energy law or sequential measurement is claimed

calibration.reference_interpretation: half of the measured +m/-m spectral gap is mapped to the row-2 511 keV benchmark; this shift-invariant calibration does not identify a physical rest mass

not_established: infinite-volume rest pole or Lorentz mass
